notes: v1.3.2 - the real UI size fix. The v1.3.0/v1.3.1 CSS font bump did nothing visible because nearly every element pins its own size, so bumping the base font never cascaded. This build applies native Chromium zoom (25% larger) which scales the entire interface uniformly. Also removes the temporary red diagnostic bar from v1.3.1. If 25% is too big or too small, it is a one-number change.
